title: SM-ACC-004B1: tenant-safe organization period close barrier
authority: Owner 2026-10-29 confirmed continued scoped development and existing qualified merge authority per governance; issue #25 accounting-first sequencing.
scope: Optional, organization-wide nonoverlapping date ranges with one-way close and server+PostgreSQL journal posting barrier; owner global management and accountant read, existing ledger and service no-POS behavior preserved.
out_of_scope: Full required accounting calendar, reopening, opening balances, billing, AR/AP, POS, store integrations, AI, production schema changes, financial auto-posting.
task: Implement ADR 0014 as bounded additive schema/API/SQL guard, account for concurrency against journal posting, add disposable PostgreSQL negative tenant/race tests. No production deploy.
validation: Exact-source Foundation CI (ruff, mypy, migrations upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade, pytest on disposable PostgreSQL), Governance CI, Accounting Web CI with actual BFF/browser; full diff reviewer and packet validation; physical/pilot/production NOT RUN.
stop_conditions: Main/source mismatch or overlapping live PR, permission leakage, destructive migration, broken historic journal replay or reversal, failed CI, uncertainty of SQL locking semantics, external secrets or data.
success_criteria: Owner can create non-overlapping periods and close them, accountant can read but not modify, branch grants cannot manage calendar, API/SQL journal posting into closed period is denied atomically even concurrent with closing; replay preserves original, legacy no-period journal flow remains.
